chunks: And they say: 'Glory be to our Lord. Indeed, the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled.'

key_terms.لَمَفْعُولاً: Indeed to be done / Has been fulfilled

ai.seo_question: What did the Children of Israel say when they realized God's promise was being fulfilled?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse captures the emotional transition of the Banu Isra'il from eager anticipation to humble awe upon the realization of divine promise, highlighting the spiritual discipline of recognizing Allah's absolute perfection ('Subhana Rabbina') before the fulfillment of His decree. It serves as a model for believers to maintain reverence and gratitude during times of waiting for divine justice or mercy, a theme central to the concept of 'Intizar' (awaiting the reappearance).
